scope: Post-open mechanism gate on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 virtual-nine roster. It reuses the v207 deployment-visible streaming potential-normal initializer that was sealed before Case 5 truth scoring, then applies the unchanged v215/v217.1 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS recurrence. It is not fresh validation, training, wall/RSS evidence, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can the already sealed observation-and-geometry-only full-DCT potential-normal initializer reduce the globally fixed adequate PCGLS reference from K16 to at most warm K14 while preserving every absolute and K16-matched field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation gate over all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs, and does it outperform equal-or-cheaper deterministic warm controls?

known_before_freeze.v217_1_k8_through_k15_matched_result: No globally fixed zero-start PCGLS depth K8 through K15 passes the K16-matched gate

all low64-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K1 through K14 metrics

the v218 formal, independent, and scientific decisions

opened_data_and_geometry.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5
opened_data_and_geometry.role: already opened post-open mechanism-development data only
opened_data_and_geometry.truth_use: Truth generated the already sealed synthetic observations and is used only for final metrics. It is forbidden from every initializer, PCGLS recurrence, depth selection, control choice, threshold, and fallback.

primary_initializer.name: sealed_v207_streaming_potential_normal_tau2m8
primary_initializer.source: The complete compact_initializer_only_fields.npy sealed by the v207 prediction barrier and independently recomputed before Case 5 truth scoring.
deployment_inputs: fixed PoolFire-fit affine center and 1009-dimensional non-DC affine basis
fixed tau=2^-8 streamed potential-normal geometry cache
forbidden_inputs: K16 field, residual, metric, or pass mask

solver_and_candidate_arms.solver: Unmodified strict_pcgls_v10_1 recurrence with denominator floor 1e-30 and the exact v215/v217.1 geometry-only Jacobi preconditioner.
solver_and_candidate_arms.preconditioner: Exact diag(A^T A), relative floor 1e-6, median-positive normalization, fixed by reported geometry before observations and truth metrics.
solver_and_candidate_arms.single_trajectory: For each cell, one primary warm PCGLS trajectory runs through K14 and records all K1 through K14 checkpoints.

reference.name: geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k16
reference.source: sealed v217.1 formal and independent result

solver_and_candidate_arms.candidate_selection: Select the first globally fixed primary depth K1 through K14 that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate. The same depth applies to every frame and rig. No per-cell, per-frame, per-rig, metric-dependent, or outcome-dependent selection is permitted.

sealed_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls.relevant_equal_cost_control: K15 has 15A+15A^T and is already sealed as failing K16-matched accuracy

low64_geometry_jacobi_pcgls.initializer: sealed v214 family-index-1 unregularized low64 Moore-Penrose observation proxy
low64_geometry_jacobi_pcgls.logical_cost_rule: warm depth K uses (K+1)A + K A^T because the initializer uses no exact call and has no cached exact projection

normalized_bp_geometry_jacobi_pcgls.initializer: observable normalized exact A^T y with its exact projection cached
normalized_bp_geometry_jacobi_pcgls.logical_cost_rule: warm depth K uses (K+1)A + (K+1)A^T including initializer preparation

dense_full_dct_equivalence.role: The v207 dense full-DCT initializer is physically output-equivalent to the compact initializer but retains/scans the dense response cache.
dense_full_dct_equivalence.logical_cost_rule: The same warm depth K can be represented as (K+1)A + K A^T with the dense cache; this may support initializer-family call headroom but cannot support compact-cache exact-call superiority.
dense_full_dct_equivalence.resource_boundary: The compact implementation is retained because v205/v206 established its smaller retained cache and PoolFire setup/RSS headroom. Case 5 wall/RSS remains unmeasured.

historical_dual_ridge.reason: No independently sealed PoolFire dual-ridge model has a compatible Case 5 virtual-rig input/geometry contract. Creating or adapting one after Case 5 was opened is forbidden in v218.

deterministic_controls.dominance_rule: After the cheapest passing primary depth is fixed, any non-equivalent deterministic control with componentwise equal-or-lower exact A and A^T calls that passes the same absolute and matched gates blocks a potential-normal-specific advantage claim.

matched_accuracy_ratios.denominator: The corresponding sealed/replayed v217.1 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 metric with a fixed 1e-30 numerical floor only to reject division by zero.

execution_and_cost_contract.primary_fields_retained: Retain all 14 primary checkpoint fields for independent physical-field comparison; controls may retain metrics and terminal fields only.
execution_and_cost_contract.geometry_setup_disclosure: Exact Jacobi setup and v207 compact geometry-cache construction remain separate from logical online A/A^T. No wall, RSS, setup amortization, or deployment resource claim is authorized in v218.
execution_and_cost_contract.camera_permutation_sentinel: For frame 0 of every rig, reverse labeled camera packets and stably restore camera IDs and observation blocks before replay; restored packets, inverse diagonal, initializers, primary K14 field, metrics, and selection quantities must remain invariant within 1e-10.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must not import the v218 formal runner. It independently parses all 42 raw density fields, rebuilds 13 operators and observations, validates and consumes the sealed v207/v214 initializer arrays, independently constructs the Jacobi preconditioner, implements warm PCGLS, recomputes all three K1-through-K14 families, four metrics, absolute and matched gates, dominance, camera-permutation sentinels, and exact-call ledgers, then compares with formal arrays only after its own decision is fixed.

decision_order: Any source, parent, initializer, observation, shape, finite, solver, call-ledger, camera-packet restoration, permutation, K16-reference, formal-independent, seal, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_V218.

If no primary K1-through-K14 checkpoint passes every absolute and K16-matched gate, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_INSUFFICIENT_V218 and close this external potential-normal warm mechanism.

Select the first globally passing primary checkpoint. If an equal-or-cheaper non-equivalent deterministic control also passes, conclude PASS_DETERMINISTIC_WARM_HEADROOM_BUT_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_POTENTIAL_V218 and forbid a potential-specific advantage claim.
Only if the primary passes by K14, strictly reduces both exact A and A^T relative to K16, and no eligible control dominates it may conclude PASS_CASE5_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_HEADROOM_V218.

A positive result is post-open deterministic mechanism headroom only. It does not establish learning, fresh external generalization, wall/RSS speedup, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: A valid failure closes the v207 potential-normal initializer plus geometry-Jacobi PCGLS transfer mechanism. Do not tune tau, affine rank, PCGLS depth per cell, thresholds, cache form, or regularization, and do not rescue it with CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU training.
